IDAGIO is the leading streaming service for classical music, based in Berlin and part of IDAGIO Group. The Group spans streaming, recordings, and live music partnerships, globally. Our director initiates projects across all of it: recording partnerships with orchestras, licensing talks with international labels, concert-hall collaborations in Taiwan and Japan, and new ventures.
These initiatives move fast and span many time zones. We are looking for the person at the director's side who keeps them all on track.
Tasks
You are the assistant to the sole director of IDAGIO Group and work with him daily. He travels extensively and meets industry leaders, orchestras, and institutions across Asia, Europe and the US. Every trip produces introductions, ideas, and commitments. Your job is to make sure none of them get lost. You track every thread, follow up with every party, and hold everyone to agreed deadlines, including the director.
Beyond that, you coordinate selected projects across the Group's Berlin companies, working with their Managing Directors. Decisions sit with the director and the Managing Directors. Keeping things moving sits with you.
Assistant and project support to the director
Track and follow up on the projects and partnerships the director runs across the Group. You keep an up-to-date overview of status, owners, and next steps at all times.
Maintain deadlines and flag slipping dates early. You chase open items without being asked.
Prepare agendas, briefings, and follow-ups for meetings. Maintain trackers and status summaries.
Coordinate scheduling, information flow, and documentation across internal and external stakeholders, from orchestra managements to distribution partners.
Project coordination for Moto Lab
Moto Lab Partners is the Group's newest venture: it supports classical artists and institutions in building their international presence and careers, from recordings and concert videos to release strategy and promotion.
Coordinate Moto Lab's projects from start to finish, whatever their shape: a release, a concert video production, a marketing campaign, or a partner engagement.
Act as the central point of contact between everyone involved: artists and their management, orchestras, production crews, distributors, agencies, and internal teams.
Track each project's timeline from planning through delivery, follow up on deliverables, and support project and budget administration until everything is complete and approved.

Several years of professional experience, typically 2 to 5, in an assistant, coordination, project management, or artist management role. This should not be your first job. You have managed deadlines across multiple stakeholders and worked alongside a demanding senior principal before.
A firm understanding of classical music and the industry around it: repertoire, orchestras, how recordings and releases work. A background in classical music (studies, an orchestra, a label, an agency, a concert hall) is a strong plus.
Proactive and organized by temperament. You take ownership, chase without being prompted, and flag problems early.
Comfortable running several projects in parallel and prioritizing against deadlines.
Clear, structured communication and documentation. Status is transparent to everyone at any time.
Fluent German and English (C1 or better, spoken and written). Japanese or Mandarin is a real plus given our partners in Japan and Taiwan.
Based in Berlin or willing to relocate. Occasional flexibility for calls with Asia or the US and for concert or recording dates in the evening.

A rare vantage point: you work directly with the director of a music group active between Europe and Asia, and you see every initiative across it.
Real responsibility from day one. The role exists because these projects matter and need an owner.
A small, senior, international team in Berlin with short decision paths.
Salary range: €42,000–50,000 gross/year, depending on experience.
Send a short cover note, your CV, and your earliest possible start date to apply. Tell us about one person or project you supported where your follow-through made the difference.
IDAGIO and the IDAGIO Group value diversity. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements.

Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist für 40 % des deutschen Energieverbrauchs und 36 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland verantwortlich. Da nur weniger als 1 % der 42 Millionen Gebäude in Deutschland jedes Jahr neu gebaut werden, stammt der überwiegende Teil des CO₂-Ausstoßes aus Bestandsgebäuden und ihrer veralteten Versorgungstechnik.

entwickelst präzise und zuverlässige Projektpläne und stellst sicher, dass diese termingerecht, im Budget und in hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.
koordinierst als Bindeglied zwischen Vertrieb, Kunden, Netzbetreibern und den ausführenden Unternehmen. Du kommunizierst proaktiv und verlässlich.
prüfst und verhandelst Verträge – immer mit Blick auf das beste Ergebnis für unsere Mission.
hast technisches Verständnis, das dir erlaubt, externe Planungen zu beurteilen und zu optimieren.

Wir suchen eine:n Projekmanager:in für unser Projektmanagement Team an unserem Standort in Heidelberg. Werde Teil unseres Teams und baue mit uns das größte KI-gestützte FinTech für das Gesundheitswesen auf!

s.h: Was dich in der Rolle als Projektmanager:in erwartet
s.t:
Du begleitest Arztpraxen vom ersten Tag an - von der technischen Einrichtung über die Schulung des Praxisteams bis zur aktiven Betreuung in den ersten Wochen nach dem Go-live. Dabei übernimmst du echte Verantwortung: Du managst deine Projekte eigenständig, bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Wechsel zu Nelly reibungslos klappt. Kein Tag ist wie der andere – du bist nah an den Menschen, nah am Produkt und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.
Über Nelly
Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann.

Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.
Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.
Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung.

KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.

Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Vertrieb und Technik und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit einem perfekten Start in die Zusammenarbeit mit Nelly durchstarten.
Du führst Implementierungsprojekte von A bis Z: von der technischen Integration über den Produktaufbau bis zur Schulung der Praxisteams (vor Ort & online) und der aktiven Nachbetreuung in der Hypercare-Phase (~30 Tage).
Du erkennst Risiken und Probleme im Projektverlauf frühzeitig, sprichst sie aktiv an und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein.
Du planst, koordinierst und priorisierst deine Aufgaben eigenständig und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Projektverlauf – auch wenn du mehrere Projekte parallel betreust.

Erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder in der Kundenbetreuung – und echte Lust, noch mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
Proaktivität ist für dich selbstverständlich: du denkst mit, fragst nach und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
Starke Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift – ob du 5 oder 40 Personen schulst, du trittst sicher und überzeugend auf.
Strukturiertes Selbst- und Zeitmanagement: du organisierst dich eigenständig, auch wenn viele Projekte gleichzeitig laufen.
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein – insbesondere im Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden-, Zahlungs- und Patientendaten.
Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft (regional, Baden-Württemberg); Führerschein Klasse B.
Teamorientiertes Arbeiten – deine Kolleg:innen können sich auf dich verlassen.
Nice to have: Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, Factoring oder Finance-Umfeld.

Join us on our mission to help medical innovators bring life-saving products to market faster and safer.
About REMATIQ
REMATIQ builds AI software for life sciences and medical device companies. Our platform helps teams automate complex documentation and compliance workflows, while keeping outputs traceable, reviewable, and audit-ready.
Product development in MedTech is highly complex: teams need to manage requirements, documentation, quality processes, regulatory expectations, and internal reviews across many systems and stakeholders. REMATIQ helps customers simplify this work, reduce manual effort, and move faster without compromising on quality or compliance.
We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, have raised €5.4M in Seed funding, and are now preparing for our next stage of scale and growth as we move toward Series A.
We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week .

As a Delivery Manager at REMATIQ, you will independently drive customer projects from problem framing to successful delivery. You will work closely with customers, our leadership team, Forward Deployed Engineers, MedTech Domain Experts, Product, and Engineering to turn complex customer needs into high-quality AI-powered workflows.
This is a hands-on project ownership role. You should be savvy and comfortable working with AI, software, implementation topics, and complex regulated workflows, but you will not be expected to be the technical expert or the MedTech domain expert.

Own customer delivery workstreams: Structure ambiguous problems, define the workplan, align stakeholders, manage risks, and drive projects to successful outcomes.
Lead customer interactions: Work directly with customer project teams and subject-matter experts to understand their goals, workflows, constraints, pain points, and success criteria.
Bring structure and insight: Frame complex issues clearly, break them down into practical next steps, push for insight, and turn ambiguity into decisions.
Create high-quality outputs quickly: Produce project plans, meeting materials, workflow documentation, decision documents, customer-facing drafts, internal summaries, and scalable delivery templates.
Become fluent in the REMATIQ product: Demo it, explain it, teach it, support customers after rollout, capture feedback, and identify opportunities for additional use cases.
We are looking for a top performer with exceptional project ownership, analytical horsepower, customer presence, and execution speed.

Top-tier consulting experience: 2–3 years of experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm such as McKinsey, BCG, or Bain, or a similarly high-performance environment.
Strong project ownership: You can take an ambiguous problem, structure it, identify what matters, define the workplan, and drive execution with limited guidance.
Excellent problem-solving skills: You are strong at conceptual framing, analysis, synthesis, and turning complex information into clear recommendations.
Strong customer presence: You can interact independently with customer project teams, build trust, manage expectations, and communicate clearly in meetings and written updates.
High execution quality and AI-native working style: You create strong drafts and polished deliverables quickly, and actively use AI tools to analyze, synthesize, improve outputs, and increase your own productivity.
Comfort with software and implementation topics: You are curious, fast-learning, and confident working with product, data, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions.
Startup mindset: You are adaptable, resilient, hands-on, positive under pressure, and willing to take on challenges beyond a narrow job description.
Fluency in English and German.

Unmatched exposure: Work directly with founders, customers, product teams, and technical experts while building a network across the global MedTech and life sciences industry.
Purposeful work: Be part of a mission-driven team transforming how medical devices reach the market — in an industry where quality, compliance, and patient safety mean nothing can be left to chance.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you'll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
The Senior Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of Zayo's long haul fiber deployment portfolio through direct oversight of turnkey engineering and construction partners, cross-functional leadership, and governance of multiple concurrent, large-scale infrastructure programs. This role provides both strategic direction and operational execution across complex, multi-million-dollar network expansion initiatives.
The Senior Program Manager owns program governance, capital planning, contractor strategy, executive stakeholder alignment, risk management, and portfolio performance while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Zayo quality standards.
Serving as the primary operational and contractual interface between Zayo, engineering and construction partners, customers, and executive leadership, this position drives organizational alignment across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, GIS, and Network Planning to deliver critical network infrastructure at scale.
This role also leads continuous improvement initiatives, establishes deployment best practices, mentors program managers, and influences long-term deployment strategy across the Long Haul organization.
The Senior Program Manager reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment.

Develop portfolio delivery strategies aligned with company growth objectives and capital investment priorities.
Lead cross-functional planning from business case development through engineering, permitting, construction, testing, customer acceptance, and operational turnover.
Establish program governance, delivery standards, performance metrics, and executive reporting across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Balance competing priorities, resources, and funding across multiple programs to optimize delivery performance.
Identify portfolio-level risks and dependencies and proactively implement mitigation and recovery strategies.
Provide recommendations to senior leadership regarding delivery strategy, capital allocation, contractor utilization, and execution priorities.
Executive Stakeholder Leadership

Build trusted relationships with executive leadership, customers, regulatory agencies, and strategic construction partners.
Lead executive steering committees, program reviews, and customer governance meetings.
Influence cross-functional decision making across Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and Network Planning.
Drive alignment between business objectives and deployment execution across multiple organizations.
Contractor Strategy & Vendor Performance

Lead commercial negotiations for engineering and construction agreements, amendments, and complex change orders.
Establish contractor performance scorecards, KPIs, governance processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Evaluate contractor capacity, financial performance, safety metrics, production trends, and quality performance.
Drive executive-level performance reviews and corrective action plans when contractor performance falls below expectations.
Partner with Procurement and Legal to optimize sourcing strategies and improve contractor performance across the deployment portfolio.
Portfolio Financial Management
Own portfolio-level capital planning, forecasting, and financial performance.
Manage multi-million-dollar capital budgets across numerous concurrent deployment programs.
Lead financial forecasting, variance analysis, accrual management, and executive reporting.
Evaluate commercial impacts of scope changes, schedule adjustments, and risk events.
Partner with Finance to improve forecasting accuracy and optimize capital deployment.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, operational efficiencies, and improved return on investment.
Engineering, Regulatory & Deployment Governance
Provide strategic oversight of engineering, permitting, regulatory compliance, and construction execution.
Partner with Engineering leadership to improve constructability, deployment standards, and network design efficiency.
Oversee compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory requirements including NTIA, NEPA, Section 106, Tribal coordination, Davis-Bacon, BABA, and environmental obligations.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

Develop standardized program management tools, dashboards, KPIs, and best practices.
Identify systemic risks and implement scalable operational improvements.
Leverage program data and performance metrics to improve forecasting accuracy, contractor productivity, and deployment efficiency.
Drive lessons learned across the organization to continuously improve delivery performance.
Leadership & Talent Development

Nous recrutons, pour le compte de notre client, un·e Chef·fe de Projet Génie Civil, afin de renforcer une équipe reconnue pour son expertise dans la conception, le développement et la réalisation d'infrastructures complexes.
Notre client est un bureau d'ingénieurs civils établi en Suisse, intervenant sur des projets d'envergure dans les domaines des infrastructures routières, ferroviaires et des ouvrages de génie civil. Son développement repose sur une approche alliant excellence technique, proximité avec ses partenaires et capacité à mener des projets exigeants dans le respect des plus hauts standards de qualité.
**Votre rôle**
Vous prenez la responsabilité complète de projets d'infrastructures, depuis les premières phases d'études jusqu'à la mise en service des ouvrages.
En tant que véritable chef d'orchestre, vous assurez la coordination des équipes internes, des mandataires spécialisés, des entreprises et des maîtres d'ouvrage. Vous êtes garant·e de la bonne conduite des mandats tant sur les aspects techniques que financiers et organisationnels.
Votre fonction nécessite une vision globale des projets ainsi qu'une forte capacité à anticiper les enjeux liés à la planification, aux coûts, aux risques et aux contraintes d'exécution. Vous veillez à assurer un équilibre constant entre les exigences techniques, les attentes des clients et les impératifs opérationnels.
Vous intervenez également comme interlocuteur privilégié des différents partenaires du projet et contribuez activement à la qualité des relations développées avec les collectivités publiques, les autorités et les acteurs de la construction.
**Vos responsabilités**
Vous pilotez les études et les différentes phases de conception des projets en veillant à leur cohérence technique et économique.
Vous assurez la planification générale des mandats et coordonnez l'ensemble des intervenants afin de garantir le respect des délais, des budgets et des objectifs définis.
Vous supervisez les procédures d'appels d'offres et accompagnez les maîtres d'ouvrage dans les processus liés aux marchés publics.
Vous assurez la direction des travaux et le suivi des chantiers, avec une présence régulière sur le terrain afin de garantir la qualité des réalisations et la bonne gestion des interfaces.
Vous encadrez et accompagnez les équipes de projet, favorisez la circulation de l'information et contribuez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre rigueur, votre capacité à prendre des décisions et à fédérer les différents intervenants autour d'objectifs communs.

Degree: architecture; or related field that included 60 semester hours of course work in architecture or related disciplines of which at least (1) 30 semester hours were in architectural design, and (2) 6 semester hours were in each of the following: structural technology, properties of materials and methods of construction, and environmental control systems.

OR Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the arts and sciences underlying professional architecture, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the architectural principles, methods, and techniques and their applications to the design and construction or improvement of buildings.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by at least one of the following: Related Curriculum: Degree in architectural engineering may be accepted as satisfying in full the basic requirements, provided the completed course work in architectural engineering provided knowledge, skills, and abilities substantially equivalent to those provided in the courses specified in paragraph A.

The curriculum for a degree in either architecture or architectural engineering covers function, esthetics, site, structure, economics, mechanical-electrical, and other engineering problems related to the design and construction of buildings primarily (but not exclusively) intended to house human activities.

The courses required for a degree in architecture generally place emphasis upon planning, esthetics, and materials and methods of construction, while the courses for an architectural engineering degree place equal or greater weight on the technical engineering aspects such as structural systems, mechanical systems, and the properties of materials.

Because of this difference in emphasis, persons with degrees in architecture may have a preference for work assignments that offer greater opportunities for them to express their artistic and creative abilities.

As a result, they may be more concerned with planning and design aspects of architecture, and persons with degrees in architectural engineering may be more engaged in aspects emphasizing technical engineering considerations.

Experience: An applicant lacking a degree in architecture must have had l year of experience in an architect's office or in architectural work for each year short of graduation from a program of study in architecture. In the absence of college courses, 5 years of such experience is required.

This experience must have demonstrated that the applicant has acquired a thorough knowledge of the fundamental principles and theories of professional architecture.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience at the next lower broadband NH-02, equivalent to the next to lower grade GS-11 or equivalent in the Federal Service.

Specialized experience must include serving as a professional architect, planning and management of design and construction execution work for, and lead project teams for, substantial multi-phase new construction, renovation/repair, and improvement projects for real property facilities, including utility systems, utilizing a professional knowledge of architecture.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Professional knowledge of a broad range of architectural concepts, principles, practices, techniques, and methods in building design and construction process, and an extensive familiarity with engineering disciplines; knowledge of aesthetic and functional design techniques; preparation of preliminary drawings, sketches, and construction drawings; and a broad range of architectural and construction standards, methods, practices, techniques, materials, and equipment to determine compliance with federal, state, and local codes and regulations.

Knowledge of drafting techniques and skills sufficient to convey design concepts and ideas and formulate working drawings.

Knowledge of standard contracting regulations, practices, and procedures; health, safety, and environmental requirements as outlined in applicable safety standards, regulations, and/or technical orders; program planning and budgeting cycles, financial control and budget systems, and management; environmental principles, practices, procedures, laws, regulations, and current legislative issues; and work classifications and regulatory and statutory restriction on the expenditures of appropriated and non-appropriated funds.

Knowledge of automated systems and programs such as Computer-Aided Design and Drafting, information management, project tracking, and other software programs. Ability to plan, conduct, and record site/facilities surveys and inspections.

Ability to research, analyze, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, and procedures in a variety of situations; recommend timely and economical solutions; plan and organize work; coordinate the work of other architects and engineering disciplines; communicate effectively, both orally and in writing; and maintain a good working relationship.

PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work. You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

Projektleiter\*in Deponie\- und Biogas / Klimaschutz
====================================================
Die Messtechnik GmbH ist ein junges, dynamisches Unternehmen mit Sitz in Thun. Unser innovatives Team ist spezialisiert auf die Erfassung und Verarbeitung räumlicher Daten sowie von Messdaten in den Bereichen Deponie und Biogas.
Methanemissionen aus Deponien und Biogasanlagen sind nicht nur sicherheitsrelevant, sondern haben auch grosse Auswirkungen auf das Klima. Wir lokalisieren und quantifizieren diese Emissionen und liefern unseren Kund\*innen damit wichtige Entscheidungsgrundlagen – auch im Hinblick auf den Klimaschutz.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir Dich als
Projektleiter\*in Deponie\- und Biogas / Klimaschutz
----------------------------------------------------
### Deine Aufgaben
Du wirst nach einer Einarbeitungszeit Messkampagnen auf alten Ablagerungsstandorten, in Betrieb stehenden Deponien und auf Biogasanlagen planen und durchführen. Wir sind meist zu zweit unterwegs und unterstützen dich dabei, deine gasspezifischen Kenntnisse auszubauen. Den Umgang mit den zahlreichen Messgeräten lernst Du bei uns von Grund auf.
Die im Feld erhobenen Messdaten haben alle einen Raumbezug. Daher werden sie direkt im GIS (QField) erfasst und danach im Büro mit QGIS weiterbearbeitet. Dies ermöglicht uns eine zentrale Datenhaltung und eine teilautomatisierte Auswertung der Messdaten.
Du bringst Deine Erfahrungen im Altlasten\- oder Deponiebereich ein, um im Rahmen von technischen Untersuchungen oder Sanierungsprojekten Beurteilungen durchzuführen und mögliche Lösungen aufzuzeigen.
Langfristig begleitest Du bei uns alle Schritte eines Projekts: vom Angebot über die Feldarbeit und den Bericht bis zur Rechnung. In unserem kleinen Team trägt jede\*r von uns Verantwortung für den gemeinsamen Erfolg.
Wir sind sehr spezialisiert und in einem Bereich tätig, in dem die Erarbeitung von massgeschneiderten Lösungen zwingend ist. Daher setzen wir auf Innovation, moderne Arbeitsmittel und die konstante Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden.
Du ergreifst Initiative, suchst neue Lösungen und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
### Dein Profil
* Du hast ein Studium mit naturwissenschaftlicher Ausrichtung an einer Hochschule abgeschlossen.
* Idealerweise konntest Du bereits Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Deponie, Altlasten oder Biogas sammeln.
* Du bringst Kenntnisse in der Umweltgesetzgebung mit (aus Studium oder Praxis).
* Du verfügst über GIS\-Kenntnisse (vorzugsweise QGIS) oder auch Kenntnisse in der Verarbeitung von Messdaten.
* Du schreibst stilsicher Deutsch und scheust Dich nicht, auch auf ösisch zu kommunizieren.
* Du hast Freude an der Arbeit im Feld.
* Du besitzt einen Führerschein.
* Du bist motiviert, in die Welt von Deponie und Biogas einzutauchen und dabei Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

* Ein Büro direkt beim Bahnhof Thun
